content:
Hi all, I opened a PR adding first linearization lemmas for IsCommJordan:

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36937

All checks are passing. I’m planning to contribute to Jordan algebra formalization in mathlib over the long term, and for this first PR I intentionally kept the scope small and self-contained to make review easier. I have a second linearization lemma prepared, but I’m saving it for a follow-up PR.

Any comments or review would be greatly appreciated.

I just left a small comment.
Also, a general question: did you use AI for any of the PR? That's not a problem if so, but then please say so in the PR description. (I'm seeing many PRs which forget this; which is why I'm asking everybody these days --- it's not about your PR in particular.)
Thanks. Yes, I used AI assistance for CI/debugging and module-structure fixes. I’ve added a disclosure note to the PR description.
